title: Inactive part's dialog shows a grey Inactive badge in the title row
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BADGE-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL BADGE PART A), is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is inactive.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BADGE-02), with description {Description-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL BADGE PART B), is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is active.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Inventory and click the Inactive tab.
  2. Search {Part-A} and click its row.
  3. Look at the dialog's title row and the Part Status choice.
  4. Close the dialog with ×.
  5. Click the Active tab, search {Part-B} and click its row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The dialog is titled "Edit Inventory Part" and shows a grey "Inactive" pill beside the close ×. Part Status has "Inactive" picked.
  • Step 4: The dialog closes with nothing changed.
  • Step 5: {Part-B}'s dialog shows a green "Active" pill in the same place.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-R14, S13-R3, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 3.6 (Opening the inactive part) and 3.1 (Part Status in the dialog), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).
